name: Mohave desertrue
desc: Mohave desertrue (Thamnosma montana): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 129 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Thamnosma montana, the turpentine broom, or Mojave desert-rue, is a shrub in the citrus family Rutaceae. It is native to the deserts of the southwestern United States and northern Mexico.
